R274.note: Removes the inverted negation so Order::all() is reached only by admins and non-admins get the user_id-scoped query, exactly matching the stated contract with no other change.

R275.note: Re-checks the same Roles=Admin condition inside the handler via AuthenticationStateProvider before the sink; the new errorMessage output appears only on the denied path so admins are unaffected.

R276.note: setSecure(true) closes the finding and the status text is updated to match; the only other edit is a dropped license paragraph in the header comment, which is not observable behaviour.

R277.note: Moving the mutation to @PostMapping is the correct fix and puts it under CsrfFilter, but the existing GET link that legitimately reaches the endpoint now gets 405; the write-up states this and the required client follow-up openly.

R278.note: Category is bound as a ? placeholder argument to sqlx Select instead of interpolated; query semantics and error handling unchanged, unused fmt import removed.

R279.note: Length-prefixed RESP multi-bulk framing makes CR/LF/space in userId or statusMessage inert data; only edge-case behaviour shifts (UTF-8 instead of ASCII '?' substitution, null message becomes empty string), neither blocking a legitimate caller.

R280.note: Prefix check now requires uploadsDir plus a separator (or exact equality), which excludes the uploads-backup sibling while still serving every real descendant via the same checked variable.

R281.note: Replaces the tautological realpath fallback check with structural bare-filename validation, which is the restriction the file's own docblock states (no subdirectories), so legitimate note names still save and traversal forms are rejected with the same 403.

R282.note: AES/GCM/NoPadding with a fresh 12-byte SecureRandom IV and 128-bit tag closes the ECB weakness; the IV is prepended to the ciphertext so the key holder can still decrypt, and the 400 path is unchanged, with the format change stated plainly.

R283.note: setObjectInputFilter with an allowlist of RestoredSession plus !* and resource limits keeps the native wire format, still restores userId/cartId, and rejected payloads surface as the existing IllegalArgumentException since InvalidClassException is an IOException.

R284.note: Switching to {{ }} escapes the description and closes the XSS, but the descriptionHtml key and raw directive signal rich-text intent and the contract contemplates sanitization; escaping flattens any legitimate formatting to literal tags, a change the write-up states rather than sanitizing.

R285.note: Random filename plus content sniffing closes both traversal and type spoofing, but the fix also discards client filenames from storage and the response, normalizes extensions, tightens permissions to 0600, and rejects files DetectContentType cannot identify (e.g. an empty PDF-labelled upload); all stated, none required by the contract.
